translationRepairs: In the third month, on jiawu, rites at Daoling were completed and a great amnesty was proclaimed.
In the third month, on jiachen, rites at Daoling were completed and a great amnesty was proclaimed.
s0051 has 三月甲辰; 甲辰 is jiachen, so replacing mistaken jiawu is required and the rest of the sentence is unchanged.
Third month, on jiawu, Daoling rites were completed and a great amnesty was proclaimed.
Third month, on jiachen, Daoling rites were completed and a great amnesty was proclaimed.
s0051 has 三月甲辰; 甲辰 is jiachen, not jiawu, so the literal day-name correction is accurate.
In the fourth month, on gengwu, Zhangzong’s Primary Consort Li shi and Palace Woman Jia shi were put to death.
In the fourth month, on gengchen, Zhangzong’s Primary Consort Li shi and Palace Woman Jia shi were put to death.
s0054 has 四月庚辰; 庚辰 is gengchen, so replacing mistaken gengwu is required and the rest is accurate.
Fourth month, on gengwu, Zhangzong’s Primary Consort Li shi and Palace Woman Jia shi were killed.
Fourth month, on gengchen, Zhangzong’s Primary Consort Li shi and Palace Woman Jia shi were killed.
s0054 has 四月庚辰; 庚辰 is gengchen, not gengwu, so the literal day-name correction is accurate.
In the first year of Chongqing, on yiyou, the new moon of the first month, the era name was changed and an amnesty was proclaimed.
In the first year of Chongqing, on jiyou, the new moon of the first month, the era name was changed and an amnesty was proclaimed.
s0199 has 正月己酉朔; 己酉 is jiyou, so replacing mistaken yiyou is required.
First year of Chongqing, first month, on yiyou the new moon: the era name was changed and an amnesty was proclaimed.
First year of Chongqing, first month, on jiyou the new moon: the era name was changed and an amnesty was proclaimed.
s0199 has 正月己酉朔; 己酉 is jiyou, not yiyou, so the literal day-name correction is accurate.

In Zhongtong year three of our dynasty, Hanlin Academician-in-Chief Wang He set out to write the history but could not recover events from the Da'an and Chongqing reigns. He gathered edicts of the day and turned to Dou Xiang, a former Jin Ministry of Revenue clerk of eighty-nine, still keen of eye and ear and able to recall old affairs — from him he obtained a little more than twenty entries.

In Zhongtong year three of our dynasty, Hanlin Academician-in-Chief Wang E set out to write the history but could not recover events from the Da'an and Chongqing reigns. He gathered edicts of the day and turned to Dou Xiang, a former Jin Ministry of Revenue clerk of eighty-nine, still keen of eye and ear and able to recall old affairs — from him he obtained a little more than twenty entries.
s0192 names 王鶚; 鶚 is È, so Wang E is correct and Wang He is a mistranslation.

In our dynasty's Zhongtong year three, Hanlin Academician Wang He, as chief compiler, wished to write a history; he could not obtain matters from Da'an and Chongqing, but collected edicts of the time; the former Jin Ministry of Revenue clerk Dou Xiang, eighty-nine years old, clear in sight and hearing and able to remember old events — from him he got more than twenty items.

In our dynasty's Zhongtong year three, Hanlin Academician Wang E, as chief compiler, wished to write a history; he could not obtain matters from Da'an and Chongqing, but collected edicts of the time; the former Jin Ministry of Revenue clerk Dou Xiang, eighty-nine years old, clear in sight and hearing and able to remember old events — from him he got more than twenty items.
s0192 names 王鶚; 鶚 is È, so the literal correction from Wang He to Wang E is accurate.
Then Grand Councilor Pusan Duan and others reported: "Palace Lady Jia should have weaned in the eleventh month; three months have passed since.
Then Grand Councilor Pusan Duan and others reported: "Palace Lady Jia should have given birth in the eleventh month; three months have passed since.
s0047 承御賈氏當以十一月免乳, in a pregnancy-and-heir context with Fan's 產期 in s0048, means expected delivery, not weaning; the proposed wording is accurate.
At this Grand Councilor Pusan Duan and others memorialized: "Palace Lady Jia should have ended nursing in the eleventh month; it is now three months past.
At this Grand Councilor Pusan Duan and others memorialized: "Palace Lady Jia should have given birth in the eleventh month; it is now three months past.
s0047 免乳, parallel to Fan's 產期 in s0048, means childbirth/delivery, not ending nursing; the proposed literal wording is accurate.
Participation Councillor Pusan Duan was appointed right chancellor.
Grand Councilor Pusan Duan was appointed right chancellor.
s0053 has 平章政事僕散端; 平章政事 is Grand Councilor, not 參知政事 (Participation Councillor), matching the chapter's own rendering of the same title in s0047.
Participation Councillor Pusan Duan was made right chancellor.
Grand Councilor Pusan Duan was made right chancellor.
s0053 has 平章政事; that office is Grand Councilor, not Participation Councillor, so the literal title correction is accurate.
